instructions.zh: 打开游戏安装文件夹。如果通过 Steam 安装，可在库中右键点击游戏，选择「管理」→「浏览本地文件」。
instructions.en: Open the game's installation folder. For a Steam installation, right-click the game in your library and choose Manage → Browse local files.

instructions.zh: 在打开的游戏文件夹中，依次双击 platform → steam → ue4ss，再单击选中 UE4SS.log（必需），将它拖入日志上传区域。
instructions.en: In the game folder, double-click platform → steam → ue4ss in order. Then click UE4SS.log (required) to select it and drag it into the log upload area.

instructions.zh: 只有作者要求时，才需添加同目录的 UE4SS-settings.ini。选好文件后，填写昵称并点击发送。
instructions.en: Add UE4SS-settings.ini from the same folder only if the author requests it. Once your files are selected, enter your nickname and click Send.
